subject: Request: pilot runway extension + sandbox credit due to connector stall
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@greenline.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot behind schedule — ETA shift & request for runway support

Hey Marissa,

Quick note from our side — the Greenline connector work hit a blocker in the mapping layer when we started exercising long documents. Our engs traced it to a dependency mismatch in the adapter; the fix looks straightforward but will take ~2–3 weeks to QA and push. That pushes our demo and evaluation window out and puts us at risk of not being able to finish the pilot on the current credits.

Ask: could Redwood extend our pilot window by 30 days and add a sandbox credit top-up (~50k tokens) so we can continue realistic throughput testing once the fix lands? We need tokens to run end-to-end runs (ETL -> embedding -> rerank) and keep momentum with our PoC stakeholders.

I attached logs that show repeated out-of-memory on long sequences — hope that helps.

Proposed new timeline: fix and internal QA by 3 weeks, re-run integration tests in week 4, schedule demo in week 5.

Really hoping we can avoid restarting procurement; it would slow us down a month+. Let me know what you need from our side to approve this.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Moreno
CTO, Greenline Analytics
alex.moreno@greenline.ai
(415) 555-0184

Attachment: greenline-test-logs.zip (text archive, 1.3MB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@greenline.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot behind schedule — ETA shift & request for runway support

Hi Alex — thanks for the details and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the mapping adapter issue; it sounds like a focused engineering fix.

We can absolutely support you — provisional offer: I can immediately push 10k sandbox tokens to your account so you can continue smoke tests while we review internally. I will escalate the ask for the remaining 40k tokens and a 30-day extension to our approvals queue right away.

Quick Qs to help with approval:
- Are you expecting to need any dedicated capacity or higher concurrency during the re-run, or is this purely sandbox testing?
- Can you confirm the single-team ETA (conservative) for the fix (best/worst case)?

Looping Ben and Stephanie for approvals and to confirm next steps. I’ll follow up once I have the formal sign-off.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot behind schedule — ETA shift & request for runway support

FYI — Greenline (GLN-2027-PILOT-1129) hit an adapter mapping blocker. They asked for +30 days and ~50k sandbox tokens (10k I already pushed).

Deal context: $135k ARR expansion potential if pilot converts; currently in POA stage with exec sponsor. Their eng lead estimates 2–3 weeks to fix and another week for integration tests.

Requesting approval: additional 40k sandbox tokens and a 30-day pilot extension. Recommend granting as a one-time safety net to keep momentum; tie credits/extension to a quick post-fix check-in and a renewed demo date.

If approved, I’ll confirm amounts to Alex and update HubSpot.

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot behind schedule — ETA shift & request for runway support

Agree with Ben — approve the 40k token top-up and 30-day extension. Please condition the extension on a short written note from Greenline confirming the new demo date and that they will run the regression tests within the next 4 weeks. Tie any additional concessions to a renewal conversation.

Also: log this as a credit adjustment and attach the credit note PDF to the deal record. See internal guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/sales/pilot-credit-guidelines

—Stephanie
VP, Sales Operations
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@greenline.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot behind schedule — ETA shift & request for runway support

Alex — good news: we approved a 30-day extension and a total 50k sandbox token package for Greenline (10k already applied; additional 40k has been granted). Attached is the formal credit note (greenline-credit-note-20270719.pdf) and I’ve updated your HubSpot record.

Conditions: please confirm the updated demo date once your engs have a firm QA window and drop a short note here confirming you’ll run the integration regression within the extension period. Per Stephanie’s request, we’ll treat additional concessions as part of a renewal negotiation.

Next steps: can we book a 30-minute sync on Thu, 22 Jul at 10am PT to validate progress and re-schedule the demo? If that doesn’t work, propose two alternative times.

Thanks — we want to keep this moving and avoid procurement churn.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
